meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 里添加 iMessage 通道:复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、跑构建和测试,再引导你配置本地(macOS)或 Photon 远程模式并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词,或要求接入 iMessage 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 通道
say.note: 进入配置流程,先让你选 local 或 remote。
需要 macOS 并给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限。

say.text: 用 Photon 远程接入 iMessage
say.note: 需要提供 Photon 服务器地址和 API key。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, runs build and tests, guides you through local (macOS) or Photon remote setup, restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc., or ask to set up iMessage.

say_en.note: Starts setup; you choose local or remote.

say_en.text: Set up iMessage in local mode.
say_en.note: Needs macOS and Full Disk Access for Node.
You'll need the Photon server URL and API key.
